signal: IMPLAN launched its Forward Linkages suite (Price Change and Downstream Contribution Insights) after the Charlesbank acquisition

email.body1:
Stephanie, saw IMPLAN shipped the Forward Linkages suite and is leaning into a bigger downstream growth story post-Charlesbank.

New capability usually means new accounts to chase, and in RevOps the gap is rarely leads, it's signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can route and touch them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IMPLAN off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stephanie, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

Most RevOps teams lose pipeline in the handoff: a signal fires, then sits for days before anyone acts. That latency is measurable, and it's usually the difference between a booked meeting and a cold account.

I'd walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change in the signal-to-touch flow. Our best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%. Want to grab 15 minutes so I can show you?
email.body3:
Stephanie, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stephanie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know RevOps roadmaps fill up fast, especially mid-integration after a new owner comes on.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to IMPLAN either way.
